hooks.command: G="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/agent-team/guard.py"; IN=$(cat); if [ -z "$IN" ]; then echo "[ai-dev-team guard] BLOCKED: empty hook input; failing closed" >&2; exit 2; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$G" ]; then printf '%s' "$IN" | python3 "$G" --shared-mode; RC=$?; if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] || [ "$RC" -eq 2 ]; then exit "$RC"; fi; echo "[ai-dev-team guard] BLOCKED: guard exited with code $RC; failing closed" >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$IN" in *'"agent_id"'*) echo "[ai-dev-team guard] BLOCKED: python3 or guard.py is unavailable; failing closed for subagent calls" >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0
